data.name: Escape The Hostel
data.detailed_description:
Escape The Hostel is a first-person horror experience set inside a dark and unsettling hostel.

You wake up trapped deep within the building, with only one objective: escape. Explore multiple floors, uncover hidden clues, solve puzzles, and manage your limited resources while trying to avoid a dangerous enemy that is always nearby.

Use your flashlight wisely, search every room for useful items, unlock new paths, and stay alert. Sometimes running is your only option. Other times, you'll need to think carefully to survive.

Can you make it to the exit before it's too late?

Features:

• Explore a mysterious multi-floor hostel

• Solve environmental puzzles and uncover clues

• Use items to aid your survival

• Experience tense chase sequences

• Immersive first-person horror gameplay

• Atmospheric environments designed to keep you on edge

data.short_description: Escape The Hostel is a first-person horror game where you must explore a mysterious hostel, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and survive while being hunted by a relentless enemy. Find your way to freedom before it's too late.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains scenes of psychological horror, tense chase sequences, depictions of violence, corpses, and themes involving danger and survival. The game may include mild blood effects and disturbing environments intended to create fear and suspense. No sexual content or explicit nudity is present.
